name: Alexander King
bio: Alexander King is a musician, actor and writer from York, England. Originally a songwriter and composer, playing in bands for most of his life as a guitarist and singer, he has gone on to create atmospheres and music for theatre productions and compose scores for films. He has acted in many regional theatre productions and has film credits including Chestersberg (2020) and The Droving (2020). His debut novel "It Looks Like You're Writing a Letter" was published in 2014.
